My love,

Happy birthday 🎂💖 Twenty-seven years ago today the world got a little brighter ✨, and somehow I'm the lucky one who gets to stand in that light every single day.

When I look back at this year, it isn't the places I remember first. It's you in them 🥰 You kicking one foot up by a red phone box in Bath ☎️. You looking out of a train window 🚆. Two coffees with little faces drawn in the foam ☕☕. The wind on the cliffs 🌊, the sand, the sea 🏖️, and you holding my hand through all of it 🤝.

You make ordinary days feel like a trip to the seaside. You make hard days feel lighter 🌤️. You make me want to be better, and you never once make me feel like I have to be.

Thank you for your laugh 😂, your patience, your kindness 💗, your beautiful stubborn heart, and for choosing me, again and again 💍.

Today I hope you feel even a fraction of how loved you are 💞 I'll keep holding your hand on every road, every train and every adventure ahead of us 🗺️❤️

Forever yours,
Aakash 😘
